{{Quote|Just so you know, this isn't personal. I have to kill you, but it's for love.|Feylara|<ref name="Distressed" />}}
During the [[Hunt for the treasure of Nok Drayen]], [[Feylara Raed]] '''lured''' a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Celestial Crow]]'', to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. She hoped doing this would persuade her former lover, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] rival [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], to get back together with her. Responding to a fake distress call, the smuggler and a companion boarded the ''Celestial Crow'', fighting past many [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They found Feylara in the ship's cargo bay, behind a [[Ray shield/Legends|shield]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Ship's engines burned out. Power cells fading, losing life support. Can't hold out much longer--I'm drifting into a sun!|Feylara's distress call|<ref name="Distressed" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the notorious criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] was humiliated when a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Search for Skavak|stole back]] [[The Voidhound's XS stock light freighter|their starship]] from him on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The two became fierce rivals,<ref name="Distressed" /> as they both sought the treasure of the legendary [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]].<ref name="Race the Devil">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Race the Devil|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref> [[Feylara Raed]], a woman who had previously been in a relationship with Skavak, believed that she could win him back by [[Death/Legends|killing]] his rival.<ref name="Distressed" />

Feylara sent the Captain's ship a distress call. The Captain, along with their crew members [[Bowdaar]] and [[Corso Riggs]], listened as Feylara claimed that she needed help. She said her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Celestial Crow]]'', was experiencing severe malfunctions —the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] had burned out, the [[power cell]]s were fading, and she was losing [[Life support/Legends|life support]]—and was now drifting into a [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="Distressed" />
